[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"I help busy people make space for the life happening around them."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"A steady route back from running on empty, without overhauling your whole life."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Start with a free, unhurried conversation, come as you are, and we'll take it from there."}]}]}]

[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Getting back to steady took honest conversation, small practical changes, and time. That's the work I now do with clients, no jargon, no quick fixes, just a grounded way back to yourself."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"I came to Maya convinced I just needed better time management. What I actually needed was permission to slow down, and a plan for how."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Coaching built around the four places overwhelm tends to show up first."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"A few words from clients who arrived overwhelmed and left with something sustainable."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"One-to-one coaching for busy people who are holding it together on the outside, and running on empty underneath."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"I run two businesses and thought exhaustion was the entry fee. Turns out boundaries didn't slow anything down, they made the work better."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Simple, repeatable practices for a racing mind, ones that hold up on your busiest days."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Four ways we can work together each one grounded in what your everyday actually looks like, not an idealised version of it."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Ways to manage a full workload without letting it quietly take over your evenings, weekends and sleep."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"version of you is still in there."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Small, steady changes now are easier than a rebuild later. Start where you are."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Learning to switch off without guilt, so downtime actually leaves you feeling like yourself again."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"The breathing work felt too simple to matter. Six months on, it's the first thing I reach for when a day starts to slide."}]}]}]

[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"My own wake-up call came quietly, missed dinners, a shorter fuse, sleep that never quite arrived. On paper things looked fine. In practice, I was running on fumes and calling it ambition."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Grounded techniques that fit into a commute, a lunch break, a hard week."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"You don't need to wait until everything falls apart."}]}]}]

[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"After redundancy I couldn't tell if I was grieving or relieved. Maya gave me room to be both, then helped me work out what came next, without rushing me toward an answer I wasn't ready for."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Support through new roles, endings, and the unsettled in-between."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Small, sustainable changes to how you eat, move and sleep, the kind that hold up on your busiest days, not just your best ones."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Fortnightly sessions built around your actual week, honest conversation, practical next steps, and space to think clearly."}]}]}]
[{"children":[{"type":"none","children":[{"text":"Our sessions never felt like therapy-speak. Just honest conversation and small changes that actually stuck."}]}]}]
